analysis.narrativeEn:

· Current Price ($1.01) vs SMA5 ($1.02)/SMA20 ($1.06)/SMA50 ($1.08) — below short/mid-term trends.
· Significantly below SMA100 ($1.18)/SMA200 ($1.31) — indicating weakened long-term trend.
· 52-week position (0.8%) + current price range near 52-week low ($0.99).
[Momentum Indicators]
· RSI Trajectory (34.9→36.5) — attempting to exit oversold territory, preparing to enter neutral zone.
· MACD Histogram Trajectory (-0.0048→-0.0044) — confirmation of improving signal during bearish convergence.
· Bollinger Band Current Price Position (near lower band $1.00) — approaching lower band, band width narrowed to 10.86%.
[Support & Resistance Structure]
· Swing Support ($1.01) — matches 52-week low and current price.
· Swing Resistance ($1.13) — requires surpassing 5-day high ($1.05) and upper Bollinger band ($1.12).
· 5-day/20-day High/Low Pattern — 5-day low ($0.99) and 20-day low ($0.99) are similar, confirming sideways pattern.
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume Ratio (0.94x) — normal level, moderate confidence in price movement.
· Current Phase Diagnosis (Accumulation Phase) — maintaining a wait-and-see approach due to RSI's oversold exit attempt and ADX's lack of trend.
